42387474.exclusion_reason: clinical/laboratory prediction model using tabular ultrasound-descriptor and lab variables (testicular blood flow, echotexture, procalcitonin); not image-based AI

42388405.clinical_problem: Assessing skeletal maturity (Risser stage) for remaining growth potential in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis

42388405.headline_result: AUC 0.938, accuracy 0.875, kappa 0.748 for binary Risser stratification; reduced reading time 9.7-11.8s per case with model assistance
42388405.study_design: single-center retrospective model development with independent reader study

42388502.exclusion_reason: primarily statistical modeling (logistic regression, group-based trajectory modeling) of ultrasound-derived fetal growth measurements; machine learning used only as a secondary exploratory comparison

42389687.exclusion_reason: veterinary (livestock) ultrasonography study, not human pediatric imaging

42390006.exclusion_reason: general review of low-field MRI technology across ages and body regions; AI-assisted reconstruction mentioned only in passing, not evaluated; not focused on pediatric imaging

42394112.clinical_problem: Automating fetal ultrasound biometry, image segmentation, and report generation to support prenatal diagnostics
42394112.patient_population: project dataset of fetal ultrasound examinations (Qatar)
42394112.model_description: Project overview of an AI ecosystem for fetal ultrasound analysis including FetSAM (a segmentation model for fetal head biometry, DSC 0.901), an automated reporting system (FADA), super-resolution techniques, and evaluation of vision-language models for ultrasound interpretation.

42394112.study_design: project overview / narrative summary of multiple AI development and evaluation studies

42394239.exclusion_reason: review of postmortem examination techniques (imaging, molecular); AI mentioned only in passing as one systemic improvement, not a described AI model

42395603.clinical_problem: Diagnosing necrotising enterocolitis in premature/very low birth weight neonates from abdominal radiographs
42395603.patient_population: premature and very low birth weight neonates (10 studies)
42395603.model_description: Systematic review and meta-analysis of AI (mostly CNN) models applied to abdominal radiographs to diagnose or stratify necrotising enterocolitis.

42396272.exclusion_reason: adult knee osteoarthritis / genetic (GWAS) study using DXA-derived alignment measurement; not pediatric

42398825.clinical_problem: Identifying neuroanatomical subtypes underlying insomnia symptoms in adolescents to understand risk for depression and anxiety
42398825.model_description: A generative deep learning model applied to gray matter volume MRI data identifies two neuroanatomical biotypes among adolescents with insomnia symptoms, differing in brain structure deviations and psychiatric risk.
42398825.headline_result: Two biotypes differ in DSM-5 depression score (p=.021) and internalizing behavior score (p=.041); validated in an adult sample
42398825.study_design: retrospective cohort study with generative deep learning biotyping and external validation in an adult sample

42400647.model_family: deep learning (contrast amplification), post-processed with HDR algorithm
42400647.clinical_problem: Enhancing lesion contrast on brain MRI in children with brain tumors without additional contrast dose, using an algorithm trained on adult data
42400647.patient_population: 22 pediatric patients (0-17 years) with brain tumors, retrospective monocentric
42400647.model_description: A deep learning algorithm trained on adult MRI, tested for cross-population generalization to pediatric brain tumor patients (including infants 0-2 years), takes pre- and post-contrast T1-weighted images as input and outputs an image with amplified contrast enhancement, further processed with an HDR algorithm.
42400647.headline_result: CNR +186.5%, LBR +61.9%, CEP +110.4%; readers preferred amplified images in 54.5-81.8% of cases
42400647.study_design: retrospective single-center evaluation of a cross-population (adult-trained) deep learning algorithm

42401764.clinical_problem: Understanding current adoption, barriers and enablers of AI in pediatric radiology departments globally
42401764.model_description: An international cross-sectional survey of 18 pediatric radiology department leaders on AI tool deployment (bone age, segmentation/quantification, protocol optimization, natural language processing), barriers, and enablers.
42401764.headline_result: 88.9% of centers implementing at least one AI tool; bone age assessment most common (44.4%)

42402632.exclusion_reason: narrative review of the gut-microbiome-brain axis in autism; neuroimaging and machine learning mentioned only as part of a broader mechanistic discussion, not a focused imaging AI topic

42403100.model_family: CNN with multi-level attention and dynamic convolution modules
42403100.body_region: fetal biometry (head, abdomen, femur), placental/umbilical Doppler
42403100.clinical_problem: Predicting severe fetal growth restriction before clinical signs appear, to guide surveillance
42403100.patient_population: 598 singleton pregnancies (299 severe FGR, 299 controls), prospective
42403100.model_description: A CNN with attention and dynamic convolution modules integrates first- and second-trimester fetal ultrasound images (biometry, Doppler, amniotic fluid) with maternal serum biomarkers to predict severe fetal growth restriction.
42403100.dataset_size: 598 singleton pregnancies (299 severe FGR, 299 controls) from 13,991 initially recruited
42403100.study_design: prospective case-control study with deep learning model development and five-fold cross-validation

42404717.model_family: multimodal Transformer (bidirectional cross-attention, Ensemble of Experts)
42404717.clinical_problem: Classifying adolescent bipolar depression with verbal auditory hallucinations from brain imaging plus clinical data
42404717.model_description: A multimodal Transformer model combines 1H-MRS-derived brain metabolite features (ventromedial prefrontal cortex) with clinical parameters to classify adolescents with bipolar depression by presence of verbal auditory hallucinations.
42404717.headline_result: Classification accuracy 71.43%; precision, recall, F1 all 0.75
42404717.study_design: retrospective small-cohort study with multimodal deep learning classification

42404839.exclusion_reason: survey of pediatric stroke care pathways; AI tools mentioned only as an underutilized survey item, not described or evaluated

42405980.clinical_problem: Whether general-purpose generative AI can produce synthetic pediatric neuroradiology images suitable for teaching diagnostic errors in pediatric neuroradiologic emergencies
42405980.model_description: Two general-purpose generative AI image tools (GPT-5, Gemini 3 Pro/Nano Banana Pro) were prompted to generate synthetic pediatric neuroradiology images depicting 22 clinical scenarios of diagnostic errors, rated for teaching quality by 8 pediatric radiologists.
42405980.release_evidence: GPT-5 (OpenAI) and Gemini 3 Pro with Nano Banana Pro (Google) are named commercial generative AI products
42405980.dataset_size: 220 generated images (22 scenarios x 5 images x 2 applications)
42405980.headline_result: 8.6% (19/220) of images rated suitable for teaching by more than half of radiologists; GPT-5 12.7% vs Gemini 4.5% (P=0.031)
42405980.study_design: reader study evaluating generative AI image quality for teaching

42406029.clinical_problem: Detecting subtle focal cortical dysplasia-like lesions in focal epilepsy, especially when standard 3T MRI is negative
42406029.patient_population: 87 patients with focal epilepsy (78.1% pediatric), 10 healthy controls
42406029.model_description: A pre-trained surface-based graph neural network classifier (from the Multi-centre Epilepsy Lesion Detection project) analyzes T1-weighted and FLAIR 7T MRI to identify lesion clusters consistent with focal cortical dysplasia, compared against 3T MRI, EEG, and histopathology.
42406029.dataset_size: 87 patients (70 after quality control), paired 7T/3T MRI
42406029.headline_result: Classifier detected previously hidden lesions in 15/40 (37.5%) classifier-positive patients; concordant with stereo-EEG in 7/10 (70%)
42406029.study_design: retrospective cohort study applying a pre-trained GNN classifier to paired 7T/3T MRI

42410243.clinical_problem: Quantifying accelerated brain aging/neurodegeneration in children with GM1 gangliosidosis using predicted brain age
42410243.patient_population: 41 Type II GM1 gangliosidosis patients (26 juvenile, 15 late-infantile) and 556 neurotypical controls
42410243.model_description: A machine learning MRI analysis pipeline (BrainStructuresAges) predicts brain age and a Brain Structures Age Gap Estimation (BSAGE) from structural MRI scans, applied to compare GM1 gangliosidosis patients against neurotypical controls.
42410243.dataset_size: 81 MRI scans from 41 GM1 patients; 897 MRI scans from 556 neurotypical controls
42410243.headline_result: Brain aging rate 0.83/year (controls) vs 1.57 (juvenile GM1) vs 12.25 (late-infantile GM1)
42410243.study_design: cross-sectional and longitudinal cohort study using a machine learning brain-age pipeline

42410361.model_family: deep learning (spatiotemporal backbone, attention-based multi-instance learning)
42410361.clinical_problem: Triage and subtype classification of common congenital left-to-right shunt lesions (VSD, ASD, PDA) from echocardiography
42410361.patient_population: 2,373 echocardiography examinations (800 normal, 493 VSD, 751 ASD, 329 PDA), single center
42410361.model_description: EchoHMIL encodes echocardiography cine clips with a spatiotemporal backbone and aggregates them via attention-based multi-instance learning to classify examinations as normal vs. shunt lesion, then subtype VSD/ASD/PDA.
42410361.headline_result: AUC 0.957 for shunt detection; 88.8% accuracy, macro-F1 0.885 for subtype classification
42410361.study_design: retrospective single-center model development and testing

42414133.clinical_problem: Automated measurement of Cobb angle and coronal balance for scoliosis monitoring, compared to manual measurement
42414133.patient_population: 29 patients aged 5-25 years with confirmed scoliosis (144 radiographs)
42414133.model_description: Commercial AI software (IB Lab SQUIRREL) automatically measures Cobb angle and coronal balance on EOS whole-spine radiographs, compared against manual measurements by expert readers across longitudinal follow-up exams.
42414133.release_evidence: an AI-driven commercial software (IB Lab SQUIRREL, IB Lab GmbH, Vienna, Austria)
42414133.headline_result: ICC 0.969-0.993 vs human readers; mean Cobb angle difference 0.2-0.7 degrees; 90.9% accuracy detecting progression >=5 degrees

42414392.clinical_problem: Detecting fractures on pediatric plain radiographs to reduce missed fractures in emergency settings
42414392.patient_population: 1,221 pediatric radiographs, KAUH Pediatric Fracture X-ray Dataset, Jordan
42414392.model_description: A binary classifier combining an EfficientNetV2-Small CNN backbone with proximal policy optimization (PPO) reinforcement-learning fine-tuning distinguishes fracture from normal pediatric radiographs, using a confidence-aware reward to penalize high-confidence misses.
42414392.dataset_size: 1,221 pediatric radiographs (KAUH Pediatric Fracture X-ray Dataset)
42414392.study_design: retrospective single-center model development, research prototype

42414724.model_family: deep learning (dual-branch domain adaptation, evidential deep learning)
42414724.clinical_problem: Improving generalization of automated fetal echocardiographic view recognition across different centers/scanners for prenatal congenital heart disease screening
42414724.model_description: A domain-adaptation deep learning framework (dual-branch consistency regularization, evidential uncertainty weighting, selective batch-norm fine-tuning) improves cross-center generalization of automated fetal echocardiographic standard-view recognition without needing labeled target-site data.
42414724.headline_result: Improved mean recognition accuracy by 0.88-2.55% across six models; DenseNet best external test accuracy 82.29%
42414724.study_design: multicenter retrospective model development and domain-adaptation evaluation

42416695.exclusion_reason: dental implant classification scoping review; dental radiographic imaging is excluded per project scope, and the review explicitly excludes studies involving children

42418473.exclusion_reason: machine learning triage model using only routine laboratory parameters; no imaging input (explicitly aims to reduce need for radiographic screening)

42418862.exclusion_reason: review of computational anthropomorphic phantoms and Monte Carlo dosimetry; AI/digital-twin mentioned only in passing as an emerging tool, not evaluated; not focused on pediatric imaging

42419604.exclusion_reason: adult compensated advanced chronic liver disease (elastography ML score for portal hypertension); not pediatric

42420692.model_family: YOLO (you-only-look-once) with wavelet transform and attention mechanism
42420692.clinical_problem: Differentiating pediatric femoral neck fractures from proximal femoral growth plates and classifying fracture type (Delbet-Colonna) to guide treatment
42420692.patient_population: 5,555 proximal femoral growth plates, 1,306 femoral neck fractures, 257 subtrochanteric fractures (pediatric)
42420692.model_description: A YOLO-based model with wavelet transform and attention mechanism (YOLO-WTAM) detects and classifies pediatric femoral neck fractures by Delbet-Colonna type from X-rays and distinguishes them from normal growth plates; tested as a reader-assistance tool for orthopedic surgeons of varying experience.
42420692.dataset_size: 5,555 growth plates, 1,306 femoral neck fractures, 257 subtrochanteric fractures annotated
42420692.headline_result: Internal test AUC 0.94-0.99; accuracy 79.17-87.16% with model assistance (improved vs. without); kappa improved 17-27% across experience levels
42420692.study_design: retrospective model development and multi-reader reader study

42420919.clinical_problem: Early classification of developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH) in infants from hip ultrasound
42420919.model_description: A YOLOv8-based keypoint detection model automatically identifies anatomical landmarks and computes alpha/beta angles on infant hip ultrasound images, combined with radiomic features to classify hips as normal or dysplastic (DDH).
42420919.headline_result: Average alpha angle difference 3.13 degrees, beta angle difference 4.83 degrees; classification accuracy 0.8544, F1 0.8383
42420919.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and testing

42422223.model_family: machine learning tree ensembles (Extra Trees, XGBoost, etc.)
42422223.clinical_problem: Predicting difficult laryngoscopic exposure in infants with Pierre Robin sequence from quantitative airway CT measurements, to improve preoperative airway assessment
42422223.patient_population: 214 infants with Pierre Robin sequence undergoing mandibular distraction osteogenesis
42422223.model_description: Multiple machine learning models (including Extra Trees, XGBoost) use quantitative 3D-CT airway parameters (tongue length, oropharyngeal cross-sectional area, tongue base-epiglottic angle) to predict difficult laryngoscopic exposure in infants with Pierre Robin sequence.
42422223.headline_result: Extra Trees model AUC 0.876, accuracy 0.812, F1 0.805 in temporal validation cohort
42422223.study_design: retrospective single-center model development with temporal validation cohort

42422597.exclusion_reason: histopathology / whole-slide image analysis of neuroblastoma; excluded modality per scope

42422709.exclusion_reason: AI-assisted 3D structured-light optical body scanning for scoliosis screening; not a standard radiologic imaging modality (radiography used only as reference standard, not the AI's input)

42423737.exclusion_reason: adult scoliosis population explicitly (816 adult patients); study explicitly distinguishes its task from adolescent screening

42424832.exclusion_reason: radiation dose and cancer-risk surrogate modeling after a nuclear power plant accident; not an imaging diagnostic AI

42426095.model_family: Inception-ResNet-V2 (CNN) for X-ray classification; XGBoost for multivariate height prediction
42426095.clinical_problem: Predicting future extreme height (unexpectedly short/tall) in children from hand X-ray and clinical features, and forecasting height trajectory
42426095.patient_population: children undergoing hand X-ray for bone age/height assessment
42426095.model_description: An integrated framework uses a fine-tuned Inception-ResNet-V2 CNN on hand X-ray images plus clinical features to classify children likely to have extreme height outcomes one year later, and an XGBoost model using anthropometric/clinical variables to predict height at multiple future time points.

42429771.exclusion_reason: commentary on speech-language therapy neuroplasticity claims in childhood stuttering; not about radiology AI

42431797.exclusion_reason: bibliometric/landscape analysis of AI medical-imaging clinical trials generally; pediatric inclusion is only one covariate analyzed, not the focus of the study

42432112.clinical_problem: Predicting air-enema reduction failure in children with ileocolic intussusception from ultrasound to guide timely intervention
42432112.patient_population: 5,602 children aged 4-60 months, 14 Chinese tertiary hospitals
42432112.model_description: A Vision Transformer deep learning model predicts air-enema reduction failure from static B-mode ultrasound images in children with ileocolic intussusception, compared against sonographer performance.
42432112.dataset_size: 10,151 images (8,122 training/2,029 validation) from 5,602 children; prospective external cohort of 190 patients
42432112.headline_result: Prospective cohort: ViT 93.7% accuracy vs senior sonographers 74.7%, junior sonographers 60.7% (p<0.05)
42432112.study_design: multicenter bidirectional cohort study (retrospective training, prospective external validation)

42435209.clinical_problem: Assessing bone age in late adolescence using paired hand-wrist and knee radiographs, since hand-wrist assessment alone is less reliable near skeletal maturity
42435209.model_description: A ShuffleNet v2-based dual-input model estimates bone age from paired hand-wrist and knee radiographs plus chronological age and sex, for late-adolescent patients where hand-wrist assessment alone is less reliable.
42435209.headline_result: MAE 3.77 months, RMSE 4.58 months, ICC 0.984, 98.18% of predictions within 12 months of reference standard
42435209.study_design: retrospective single-center model development and internal validation

42435380.model_family: weakly supervised deep learning segmentation algorithm
42435380.clinical_problem: Quantifying white matter perivascular space burden in children with autism spectrum disorder versus typically developing controls, to test as a potential biomarker
42435380.patient_population: 98 children with ASD (age 2-8) and 38 typically developing children (age 2-8)
42435380.model_description: A weakly supervised deep learning segmentation algorithm automatically segments perivascular spaces on enhanced-contrast 3T structural brain MRI, generating volume and count metrics compared between children with ASD and typically developing controls.
42435380.headline_result: No significant difference in PVS volume/count between ASD and TD (p=0.228, p=0.121); no evidence of PVS as ASD biomarker
42435380.study_design: observational cross-sectional cohort study with automated quantitative MRI segmentation

42435844.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric femoral neck fracture subtypes (novel classification based on translation direction and posteromedial comminution) to guide treatment, reducing reliance on clinical experience
42435844.patient_population: 711 patients with pediatric femoral neck fractures, mean age 10.7+/-3.7 years, multicenter
42435844.model_description: A multimodal deep learning model trained on paired X-ray images and textual descriptions classifies pediatric femoral neck fracture subtypes (AP and lateral views), compared against a unimodal image-only model and pediatric orthopedic surgeons of varying experience.
42435844.dataset_size: 711 AP and 674 lateral X-rays from 711 patients
42435844.headline_result: Multimodal model AP accuracy 96.5% vs unimodal 90.1%; outperformed senior surgeons (p<0.05)
42435844.study_design: multicenter retrospective model development and comparison with human readers

42439215.exclusion_reason: clinical/laboratory/ultrasonographic risk-prediction model for outpatient biliary atresia follow-up; ultrasonographic variables are only one of many clinical/lab inputs, and top predictors are laboratory (albumin, cholestasis index, bile acids)

42442126.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of organs-at-risk for craniospinal proton radiotherapy planning in children with CNS embryonal tumors, using adult-trained models
42442126.patient_population: 40 patients aged 2-28 years with CNS embryonal tumors
42442126.model_description: Commercial deep learning auto-segmentation models (RayStation DLS), originally trained on adult head-and-neck, thorax-abdomen, and male pelvis regions, are applied sequentially to segment 60 organs-at-risk on planning CT for craniospinal proton therapy in children and young adults, evaluated against expert contours.
42442126.headline_result: Mean DSC 0.73, HD 2.45mm; 93.5% meeting HD<4mm criterion; accuracy decreased in children under 12 years
42442126.study_design: retrospective single-center geometric and dosimetric evaluation

42446277.model_family: XGBoost with statistical shape modeling / PCA
42446277.clinical_problem: Differentiating craniosynostosis from nonsynostotic cranial deformities (e.g., deformational plagiocephaly) and identifying the affected suture, to reduce unnecessary referrals
42446277.patient_population: 571 subjects (158 normal, 281 deformational plagiocephaly/brachycephaly, 132 single-suture craniosynostosis)
42446277.model_description: Head shapes derived from photogrammetry or CT are represented as 3D point clouds, reduced via statistical shape modeling and PCA, and classified using an XGBoost model to identify craniosynostosis, determine the affected suture, and distinguish it from nonsynostotic deformities like deformational plagiocephaly.
42446277.headline_result: Model-1 (synostosis vs. not): accuracy 97.8%, sensitivity 98.1%, specificity 96.9%
42446277.study_design: retrospective cross-sectional model development with cross-validation

42446839.model_family: CNN classification with CycleGAN and DeepLabV3-Plus preprocessing
42446839.clinical_problem: Classifying infant hip ultrasound images as normal or abnormal (DDH) under heterogeneous image quality, comparing preprocessing strategies to improve consistency
42446839.patient_population: infant hip ultrasound images (heterogeneous quality, two datasets)
42446839.model_description: A CNN classifies infant hip ultrasound images as normal or abnormal for DDH screening; six preprocessing strategies were compared, including CycleGAN-based domain translation and DeepLabV3-Plus segmentation preprocessing.
42446839.headline_result: Baseline AUC 0.724; segmentation preprocessing highest (AUC 0.791); no statistically significant differences between approaches
42446839.study_design: retrospective comparative model development study with cross-validation

42447010.model_family: Vision Transformer (ViT) with adversarial domain alignment
42447010.clinical_problem: Classifying pathogen type (bacterial vs viral) in pediatric pneumonia from chest imaging to support diagnosis with limited annotated data
42447010.patient_population: pediatric pneumonia patients (private CT dataset; public ChestXRay2017 dataset)
42447010.model_description: STAR-ViT, a vision transformer with spatial transformation consistency and adversarial cross-modal realignment, classifies pediatric pneumonia pathogen type (bacterial/viral/normal) from CT or chest X-ray images, aligning features across modalities to improve generalization.
42447010.dataset_size: private CT dataset; public ChestXRay2017 dataset
42447010.headline_result: 92.07% accuracy on private CT dataset; 97.86% on public ChestXRay2017 dataset
42447010.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation on two datasets

42447178.clinical_problem: Detecting and classifying (Gartland system) pediatric supracondylar humeral fractures from elbow radiographs using general-purpose multimodal LLMs
42447178.patient_population: 300 pediatric patients aged 2-10 years (150 fracture, 150 non-fracture)
42447178.model_description: Three general-purpose multimodal LLMs (ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0, Claude 3.5) were shown two-view elbow radiographs and asked to detect supracondylar humeral fractures and classify them by Gartland type, compared to expert-confirmed diagnoses.
42447178.release_evidence: ChatGPT-4o, Gemini 2.0, Claude 3.5 are named commercial LLM products
42447178.headline_result: Sensitivity: Gemini 2.0 68.4%, Claude 3.5 58.7%, ChatGPT-4o 19.3%; specificity 33.1-36.0% (high false-positive rate)
42447178.study_design: retrospective observational diagnostic accuracy study comparing general-purpose LLMs

42447261.clinical_problem: Presumptive detection of congenital heart disease from pediatric chest X-rays to support screening where echocardiography is unavailable
42447261.patient_population: 656 pediatric chest X-rays (426 with CHD, 230 without), Mexico
42447261.model_description: A ResNet-based deep convolutional neural network performs binary classification (healthy vs. cardiopathic) of pediatric chest X-rays as a proof-of-concept presumptive screening tool for congenital heart disease.

42452394.clinical_problem: Evaluating whether multimodal LLMs can accurately and safely interpret pediatric pelvic radiographs to answer caregiver questions about cerebral palsy hip displacement surveillance
42452394.patient_population: 15 deidentified pediatric pelvic radiographs, cerebral palsy hip surveillance
42452394.model_description: Three multimodal LLMs (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5 Pro) were given pediatric pelvic radiographs and caregiver questions about cerebral palsy hip displacement, and their responses were assessed for diagnostic accuracy, hallucinations, and safety disclaimers.
42452394.release_evidence: GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5 Pro are named commercial products
42452394.dataset_size: 15 pediatric pelvic radiographs, 95 responses per model
42452394.headline_result: GPT-4o disclaimer rate 96.9% vs Claude 60.0% vs Gemini 76.8% (p=0.03); Claude hallucinated bilateral hip replacements in non-operative cases
42452394.study_design: retrospective diagnostic and educational-utility evaluation study

42453641.model_family: patch-based unsupervised deep learning (age-prediction anomaly detection)
42453641.clinical_problem: Detecting fetal brain anomalies (ventriculomegaly, hemorrhage, cysts) on fetal MRI without prior knowledge of anomaly type, using deviation from predicted gestational age
42453641.patient_population: 1,316 fetuses (711 normal, 605 abnormal: ventriculomegaly, GMH-IVH, subependymal cysts)
42453641.model_description: PANDA, a 3D patch-based unsupervised deep learning model, predicts gestational age from fetal brain MRI patches and uses the maximum deviation from true gestational age across patches as a biomarker to detect brain anomalies, without being trained on abnormal cases.
42453641.study_design: retrospective cohort study, unsupervised anomaly detection model development

42454002.exclusion_reason: broad review of pain-assessment methods across many modalities; imaging and AI mentioned only briefly as one tool among many, not focused on pediatric radiology AI

42454147.clinical_problem: Objective diagnosis of ADHD in children and adolescents from resting-state fMRI, aiming for cross-site generalizability
42454147.patient_population: 760 subjects (300 ADHD, 460 controls), ADHD-200 dataset, six sites
42454147.model_description: VoxSTNet, a time-distributed 3D-CNN combined with a GRU, operates directly on raw 4D rs-fMRI BOLD volumes to classify ADHD versus control, with HiResCAM providing voxel-level interpretability.
42454147.headline_result: Five-fold cross-validation accuracy 98.7%, AUC 99.4%; Leave-One-Site-Out accuracy 78.4%
42454147.study_design: retrospective multi-site cohort study, deep learning model development with cross-site validation

42454329.model_family: machine learning classifier applied to functional connectivity features
42454329.clinical_problem: Differentiating bipolar disorder from major depressive disorder in adolescents using resting-state functional connectivity patterns
42454329.model_description: Seed-based functional connectivity analysis of default mode network subregions on resting-state fMRI, combined with machine learning classification, to distinguish adolescents with bipolar disorder from those with major depressive disorder.
42454329.headline_result: Pooled out-of-fold AUC 0.609, accuracy 0.598 (modest and unstable classification performance)
42454329.study_design: case-control observational study with machine learning classification

42455244.clinical_problem: Automated categorization of pediatric anatomical vs nonanatomical humeroradial joint alignment on radiographs, reducing reliance on clinical experience
42455244.patient_population: 5,118 pediatric radiographs for model development; external test set of 216 radiographs
42455244.model_description: A Vision Transformer model classifies pediatric humeroradial joint alignment as anatomical or nonanatomical on radiographs, and was tested as a reader-assistance tool for pediatric orthopedic surgeons of varying experience.
42455244.dataset_size: 5,118 radiographs for training (2,932 A-HRJA, 2,186 NA-HRJA); external test 216 radiographs
42455244.headline_result: ViT AUC 0.944; significantly outperformed unaided surgeons; model-assisted accuracy improved from 86.9% to 92.6%
42455244.study_design: retrospective model development and multi-reader reader study

42457802.model_family: support vector machine (SVM), multi-voxel pattern analysis
42457802.clinical_problem: Investigating whether brain activity patterns distinguish grammatically correct from incorrect sentences in children with varying language skill, using fMRI-based decoding
42457802.model_description: A support vector machine classifier using multi-voxel pattern analysis of task fMRI data attempts to distinguish neural representations of grammatically correct versus incorrect sentences in regions of interest related to phonological and semantic processing in 7-year-old children.
42457802.headline_result: Classifier performed near chance in ROIs; lower language skill associated with higher classification accuracy in bilateral regions
42457802.study_design: observational cohort study with machine learning-based fMRI decoding

42459075.model_family: super-resolution reconstruction (deep learning) + radiomics (nnUNet segmentation, gradient boosting/AdaBoost/KNN classifiers)
42459075.clinical_problem: Predicting placenta accreta spectrum disorders from T2-weighted MRI, testing whether super-resolution reconstruction improves radiomics diagnostic performance
42459075.patient_population: 603 suspected PAS cases from three centers
42459075.model_description: A deep learning super-resolution reconstruction of T2-weighted MRI combined with automated nnUNet placental segmentation and a radiomics-based classifier (Gradient Boosting) predicts placenta accreta spectrum disorders; multicenter comparison of original vs. super-resolved images.
42459075.dataset_size: 603 cases (three centers: 480 training, 66 and 57 external validation)
42459075.headline_result: Training AUC 0.874 (4x super-resolution, Gradient Boosting); external validation AUC 0.542-0.724; no significant benefit of super-resolution over original resolution
42459075.study_design: retrospective multicenter diagnostic study with external validation

42462242.model_family: hybrid CNN-Transformer with crossover boosted cheetah optimization
42462242.clinical_problem: Automated identification of spina bifida from second-trimester fetal ultrasound images
42462242.model_description: A hybrid CNN-Transformer model, combining local CNN feature extraction with transformer-based global context and a self-attention mechanism, identifies spina bifida from second-trimester fetal ultrasound images; hyperparameters tuned with a crossover-boosted cheetah optimization algorithm.

42465092.exclusion_reason: virtual simulation teaching system for medical imaging education; AI mentioned only as one contributing technology among several (computer graphics, HCI), not a specific AI model evaluated

42465722.clinical_problem: Joint segmentation of brain lesions and classification of cerebral palsy risk in infants with periventricular white matter injury, from multi-modal MRI
42465722.patient_population: 243 infants (122 with PVWMI: 90 with CP, 32 without; 121 with normal MRI)
42465722.model_description: MMSeg-CP, a SegFormer-based multi-task transformer, jointly segments anatomical target regions and lesions and classifies cerebral palsy risk from registered T1- and T2-weighted MRI in infants with periventricular white matter injury.
42465722.headline_result: Mean Dice 0.79 (target regions), 0.41 (lesions); 0.95 slice-level accuracy, 0.88 subject-level accuracy for CP classification
42465722.study_design: retrospective cohort study with multi-task deep learning model development

42466188.clinical_problem: Identifying autism-associated brain characteristics using multimodal MRI (structural, diffusion, functional) machine learning classifiers, stratified by age group
42466188.model_description: Radiomic features extracted from structural, diffusion, and resting-state functional MRI are used to train SVM classifiers distinguishing autism from typical development, compared across single- and multi-modality models and age subgroups (5-11, 12-18, and full range).
42466188.study_design: retrospective cohort study using public neuroimaging database, machine learning classification with age-stratified analysis

42467724.exclusion_reason: scoping review of ovarian multi-omics biology across the lifespan; AI/ML and radiology datasets mentioned only briefly as a future integration opportunity, not the review's focus

42468563.clinical_problem: Comprehensive multi-parameter assessment of adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (Cobb angle, coronal balance, force line) from dual-view spinal X-rays, beyond traditional Cobb angle alone
42468563.patient_population: 700 paired AP/lateral X-rays; diagnostic grading test on 142 patients
42468563.model_description: A Residual U-Net segments vertebral bodies on paired anteroposterior and lateral spinal X-rays, feeding a Local Sine-based Spinal Projection Model that computes vertebral inclination, Cobb angles, coronal balance, and force-line parameters for comprehensive scoliosis assessment.
42468563.headline_result: Vertebral segmentation Dice 94.7%; ICC 0.958 for Cobb angle; diagnostic grading 84.5% correct classification (120/142)
42468563.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study with longitudinal follow-up validation

42469410.clinical_problem: Automated measurement of spinal alignment (coronal/sagittal) and detection of spinal implants in scoliosis radiographs to streamline workflow
42469410.patient_population: 4,585 radiographs from 1,671 AIS patients, 10 institutions, 2 countries
42469410.model_description: A CNN-based AI system automatically measures coronal and sagittal spinal alignment parameters and detects spinal implants (pedicle screws and hooks) on scoliosis radiographs, validated across multiple institutions and countries.
42469410.dataset_size: 4,585 radiographs from 1,671 AIS patients across 10 institutions in 2 countries
42469410.headline_result: MAE 2.7 degrees (major curve, r=0.99), 3.7 degrees (thoracic kyphosis, r=0.91); vertebral numbering accuracy 0.97; implant detection MAE 0.18/image (r=0.99)
42469410.study_design: multi-institutional retrospective model development and external validation

42469676.clinical_problem: Stratifying risk of refractory Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children from clinically indicated chest CT
42469676.patient_population: 1,224 pediatric patients with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia, multicenter
42469676.model_description: A transformer-based deep learning framework (trans-DLF) analyzes non-contrast chest CT to stratify risk of refractory Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia in children, compared with a 3D-CNN, a clinical model, and a multimodal nomogram, with Grad-CAM interpretability.
42469676.dataset_size: 1,224 pediatric patients (multicenter, with two independent external cohorts of 331 and 108)
42469676.headline_result: AUC 0.90 internal testing, 0.89 external testing (both cohorts)
42469676.study_design: multicenter retrospective cohort study with external validation

42477623.exclusion_reason: dental panoramic radiograph periapical lesion detection; dental imaging is excluded per project scope

42477921.clinical_problem: Predicting spontaneous preterm birth from cervical ultrasound using radiomics and deep learning
42477921.model_description: Radiomics and deep learning applied to cervical ultrasound to predict spontaneous preterm birth (abstract text unavailable; based on title only).

42479162.clinical_problem: Overview of AI applications and challenges in pediatric neuroimaging across use cases including fetal, neonatal, hydrocephalus, malformations, tumors, epilepsy, demyelination, stroke, and trauma
42479162.model_description: A narrative review of AI applications in pediatric neuroimaging, covering technical principles and pitfalls, current clinical tools (mostly FDA-cleared for adult neuroradiology), and research advances in areas including fetal, neonatal, hydrocephalus, malformations, tumors, epilepsy, demyelination, stroke, and trauma imaging.

42479243.model_family: automated segmentation, radiomics, machine learning (various, reviewed)
42479243.clinical_problem: Moving from 2D linear indices (Evans index) to 3D volumetric/radiomic biomarkers for hydrocephalus assessment, including pediatric hydrocephalus monitoring, differential diagnosis of ventriculomegaly, and shunt response prediction
42479243.model_description: A narrative review summarizing automated segmentation and radiomic 3D biomarkers (vs. traditional 2D linear indices) for hydrocephalus imaging, across pediatric hydrocephalus monitoring, ventriculomegaly differential diagnosis, CSF diversion response prediction, and post-treatment follow-up.
42479243.headline_result: Machine learning models report AUCs exceeding 0.9 for differential diagnosis and shunt response prediction across reviewed studies

42479528.clinical_problem: Assessing severity of pediatric pneumonia from lung ultrasound video using AI-based scoring
42479528.patient_population: pediatric lung ultrasound clips (1,646 unlabeled for pretraining; 464/156 labeled for training/test)
42479528.model_description: PedLUS, a self-supervised video learning framework with masked-frame reconstruction and spatial/temporal attention modules, scores pediatric lung ultrasound video severity for pneumonia, mitigating scarcity of expert annotations.
42479528.release_evidence: Code and dataset will be released at: PedLUS
42479528.study_design: retrospective model development study with self-supervised pretraining

42480342.clinical_problem: Instance-level segmentation and prediction of fetal ventriculomegaly from anisotropic fetal MRI to support prenatal diagnosis
42480342.model_description: V2-Former, a query-based transformer with an Anisotropy-Aware Module and Ventricular Diagnosis Enhancement strategy, performs ventricle-specific segmentation and diagnostic prediction of fetal ventriculomegaly from anisotropic fetal MRI.
42480342.study_design: retrospective model development and comparison study

42481262.clinical_problem: Whether AI can enable lower-dose pediatric PET/CT without compromising diagnostic accuracy, through denoising, reconstruction, synthetic CT, and workflow optimization
42481262.model_description: A review of AI-enabled pathways for pediatric PET/CT dose optimization, including low-count PET denoising, image enhancement, synthetic CT, CT-free attenuation/scatter correction, motion correction, automated quality control, and protocol selection.

42482282.exclusion_reason: MR fingerprinting field-inhomogeneity estimation method, primarily adult/technical validation; only one pediatric subject mentioned incidentally among a large mixed-age multi-site dataset

42488224.model_family: radiomics + nomogram (LASSO-selected features combined with clinical/imaging findings)
42488224.clinical_problem: Differentiating Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia from bacterial pneumonia in children using CT imaging
42488224.patient_population: 585 pediatric pneumonia patients (249 MPP, 336 bacterial pneumonia)
42488224.model_description: A clinical-radiomics nomogram combines CT-based radiomics features (segmented with PHIgo-LK software), CT imaging findings, and clinical indicators to differentiate Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia from bacterial pneumonia in children.
42488224.study_design: retrospective case-control study with radiomics nomogram development

42495262.model_family: self-supervised deep learning (representation learning, anomaly detection)
42495262.clinical_problem: Detecting abnormal intracardiac microflow patterns suggestive of congenital heart disease on early-pregnancy fetal cardiac microflow ultrasound imaging
42495262.patient_population: 650 early-pregnancy fetal cardiac microflow examinations (500 internal, 150 external cohort), CHD-enriched referral population
42495262.model_description: uFlowAM, a self-supervised deep learning framework, learns a normal microflow template from control fetal cardiac microflow imaging (temporal-order discrimination and masked-frame reconstruction, no pixel-level labels) and flags abnormal intracardiac flow patterns via a latent-space abnormality index, tested as a second-reader assistive tool.
42495262.headline_result: External cohort AUC 0.92, sensitivity 0.90, specificity 0.86; reader-assisted median AUC increased from 0.85 to 0.92, reading time decreased from 78s to 59s
42495262.study_design: multicenter diagnostic accuracy study with multi-reader multi-case (MRMC) evaluation

42495270.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation and biometric measurement of the fetal brain from 3D SSFP MRI to support diagnosis of neurodevelopmental abnormalities
42495270.model_description: An end-to-end deep learning pipeline (Tri-Attention nnU-Net for head localization, nnU-Net for multi-structure segmentation) automatically segments the fetal head, brain parenchyma, and extra-axial CSF and estimates head circumference from whole-body 3D SSFP MRI.
42495270.study_design: retrospective model development and evaluation study

42495539.model_family: radiomics framework (automatic registration, segmentation, feature extraction) with GAMLSS trajectory modeling
42495539.clinical_problem: Predicting infant brain age and modeling normative brain development trajectory from routine clinical 2D MRI to detect developmental delay
42495539.patient_population: 2,893 routine T1- and T2-weighted scans from children aged 0-2 years
42495539.model_description: A radiomics framework with automatic registration, segmentation, and feature extraction predicts brain age from routine clinical 2D T1- and T2-weighted MRI in infants, and models the normative developmental trajectory of the corpus callosum median using GAMLSS to flag developmental delay.
42495539.headline_result: Brain age prediction MAE 1.19 months; developmental delay detection accuracy 0.96 (ages 6-24 months)
42495539.study_design: retrospective cohort study using routine clinical MRI with radiomics-based modeling

42497008.model_family: machine learning classifiers (SVM, random forest, KNN, multilayer perceptron) on cortical surface features
42497008.clinical_problem: Classifying childhood autism spectrum disorder from cortical surface-based structural MRI descriptors not usually visible on routine imaging
42497008.model_description: Cortical surface descriptors (volume, surface area, thickness, curvature, folding index) are extracted via FreeSurfer-based segmentation-guided reconstruction from pediatric structural MRI and classified using machine learning models (SVM, random forest, KNN, multilayer perceptron) to distinguish autism from typical development.
42497008.study_design: retrospective cohort study using public dataset (ABIDE-II), machine learning classification

42497578.exclusion_reason: protocol optimization study (chest CT scan range boundaries) with no AI model developed; AI mentioned only as a future direction in the conclusion

42498116.model_family: machine learning classifier applied to structural-functional connectivity coupling features
42498116.clinical_problem: Classifying adolescent obsessive-compulsive disorder and predicting symptom severity using structure-function coupling from multimodal neuroimaging
42498116.patient_population: 50 adolescents with OCD and 53 healthy controls
42498116.model_description: Structural-functional connectivity coupling is computed across 246 brain regions from multimodal MRI (diffusion and functional) and used with machine learning to discriminate adolescents with OCD from controls and predict symptom severity.
42498116.headline_result: SC-FC coupling discriminated OCD from controls with 66.0% accuracy (AUC 0.691, p=0.003); predicted symptom severity (r=0.426, p=0.002)
42498116.study_design: case-control observational study with machine learning classification

42499815.exclusion_reason: conference highlights review of IBD care (drug therapy, endoscopy); AI mentioned only in passing for endoscopic scoring, not focused on pediatric radiology

42501422.exclusion_reason: uses retinal optical coherence tomography angiography (ophthalmic imaging), an excluded modality; combined with clinical/PSG variables in a nomogram, not radiologic imaging

42504851.exclusion_reason: dental trauma clinical-decision chatbot comparison; dental domain excluded, and no image analysis is performed by the chatbots

42506153.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric wrist fracture subtype (buckle/torus, greenstick, Salter-Harris, other, no fracture) from plain radiographs to support settings lacking subspecialty expertise
42506153.model_description: Three ImageNet-pretrained CNN architectures (DenseNet-169, ResNet-50, EfficientNet-B4) were compared for five-class classification of pediatric wrist fracture subtype from plain radiographs, using transfer learning and Grad-CAM interpretability.
42506153.headline_result: DenseNet-169 best: balanced accuracy 0.532, macro F1 0.516, macro AUROC 0.815 (after extended training); accuracy remained below clinically usable thresholds
42506153.study_design: pilot retrospective study comparing CNN architectures with patient-level stratified split

42507172.exclusion_reason: unsupervised machine learning clustering is applied to urinary monoamine metabolite profiles, not imaging; brain structural MRI measures are compared post hoc across derived clusters but are not the object of the machine learning model

42507336.exclusion_reason: population age not specified as pediatric; children mentioned only as motivating context for why spirometry is unreliable, not as the study cohort

42510002.clinical_problem: Assessing myocardial iron overload and early subclinical cardiac dysfunction (strain) in pediatric transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia using AI-assisted CMR feature tracking
42510002.patient_population: 68 pediatric patients with beta-thalassemia major and 20 age-matched healthy controls
42510002.model_description: AI-based cardiovascular MRI feature tracking (CMR-FT) automatically measures myocardial strain (global circumferential, longitudinal, radial strain) and is correlated with T2*/T1 mapping and LV geometry to detect subclinical cardiac dysfunction in pediatric beta-thalassemia patients with myocardial iron overload.
42510002.headline_result: GCS reduced in iron overload group (-17.4% vs -19.3% in controls, p<0.01); GCS correlated with T2* (r=-0.33) and T1 (r=-0.45)
42510002.study_design: retrospective case-control study using AI-assisted CMR feature tracking

42510007.exclusion_reason: dental panoramic radiograph analysis for molar extraction prognosis; dental imaging excluded per project scope

42510090.exclusion_reason: clinical/hormonal/laboratory prediction model for growth hormone therapy response; bone age (TW3 RUS) is one of several routine clinical variables among demographic, laboratory, hormonal and family-history data, not an imaging-focused analysis

42510430.exclusion_reason: cardiac MRI reconstruction method; pediatric mentioned only as a target population motivation, but the study is validated only in healthy volunteers, not a pediatric cohort

42510487.clinical_problem: Improving prenatal detection of total anomalous pulmonary venous connection (TAPVC) via automated measurement of biometric indices (PLAS index, LAPSD ratio) on fetal cardiac ultrasound four-chamber view
42510487.model_description: Automated four-chamber view extraction from fetal cardiac ultrasound videos, using DeepLabv3+, UNet3+, or SegFormer to segment the heart, crux, and descending aorta, followed by automated measurement of the post-left atrium space index and left-atrial posterior-space-to-diagonal ratio to screen for total anomalous pulmonary venous connection.
42510487.headline_result: AE-SegFormer AUC 0.940 (PLAS) and 0.940 (LAPSD), outperforming residents (0.784-0.797) and fellows (0.801), approaching experts (0.996)

42510505.exclusion_reason: dental panoramic tooth segmentation; dental imaging excluded per project scope

42516067.exclusion_reason: review of diagnostic strategies for neonatal cholestasis/biliary atresia spanning biomarkers, genetics, and imaging; AI-assisted ultrasound interpretation is only one bullet among many non-imaging strategies discussed

42517220.clinical_problem: Detecting 28 congenital heart defects, structural/functional abnormalities, repairs, and interventions from complete pediatric echocardiography studies
42517220.patient_population: >12,000 echocardiography studies (>700,000 videos), Stanford Medicine 2014-2021; external cohort Children's Hospital of Philadelphia 2024-2025
42517220.model_description: EchoAI-Peds, a video-based vision transformer, simultaneously detects 28 congenital heart defects and structural/functional abnormalities, repairs, and interventions from multi-view pediatric echocardiography studies, outperforming adult-based echocardiography foundation models (EchoCLIP, EchoPrime).
42517220.dataset_size: >12,000 studies (>700,000 videos); training 10,815, validation 1,294, internal test 1,336, external test 2,121 studies
42517220.headline_result: Macroaveraged AUROC 0.91 internal, 0.89 external; outperformed EchoCLIP (0.58/0.61) and EchoPrime (0.58/0.60)
42517220.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and external validation study

42519176.model_family: machine learning ensemble/transfer learning/fine-tuning models (ImageNet feature extraction)
42519176.clinical_problem: Detecting the target sign of intussusception on point-of-care ultrasound in the pediatric emergency department
42519176.patient_population: 49 patients (8 positive for intussusception), POCUS media from ED visits
42519176.model_description: Multiple machine learning approaches (classical ML, ensemble learning, transfer learning, fine-tuning on ImageNet features) were compared for detecting the intussusception target sign on point-of-care ultrasound images/videos from pediatric emergency department visits.
42519176.dataset_size: 785 media files from 49 patients (converted to 1,582 intussusception and 1,965 normal images)

42520944.model_family: deep learning (signal correction, respiratory correction, super-resolution, segmentation; 4 models)
42520944.clinical_problem: Creating fully segmented, isotropic pseudo-3D cardiac cine MRI from free-breathing 2D real-time images to speed up cardiac MRI in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients
42520944.patient_population: 20 patients undergoing routine cardiovascular MRI examination
42520944.model_description: Four deep learning models (interslice signal correction, interslice respiratory correction, through-slice super-resolution, and cardiac chamber/vessel segmentation) convert a stack of free-breathing 2D real-time cardiac MRI cines into a fully segmented, isotropic pseudo-3D cine dataset, validated against breath-hold and whole-heart reference imaging in pediatric and congenital heart disease patients.
42520944.release_evidence: Our models are trained from fully open-source datasets, allowing our technique to be easily shared with other clinical centers.
42520944.headline_result: No significant bias in LV/RV volumes (e.g., LV EDV bias 0.7+/-8.8 mL); total reconstruction time under 1 minute

42522316.model_family: radiomics model (texture features) combined with clinical fusion
42522316.clinical_problem: Distinguishing idiopathic central precocious puberty from isolated premature thelarche in girls using pituitary MRI radiomics combined with clinical features
42522316.patient_population: 316 girls (231 ICPP, 85 PT) internal cohort; 47 girls external validation cohort
42522316.model_description: A pituitary MRI radiomics model (texture features, primarily sagittal anterior pituitary) combined with clinical and hormonal features (BMI, bone age, FSH, LH, E2) in a fusion model distinguishes idiopathic central precocious puberty from premature thelarche in girls, with external validation at a second center.
42522316.dataset_size: 316 girls internal (231 ICPP, 85 PT), 47 girls external validation
42522316.study_design: retrospective diagnostic study with external validation

42523910.model_family: various (XGBoost, Random Forest, CNNs, transformers; systematic review)
42523910.clinical_problem: Machine learning and deep learning for acute detection (e.g., skull fracture, CT-necessity triage) and outcome prognostication in pediatric traumatic brain injury
42523910.model_description: A systematic review of machine learning and deep learning models (including CNNs, transformers, gradient boosting) for acute detection of pediatric traumatic brain injury (e.g., skull fracture on imaging, CT-necessity triage) and prognostication of outcomes (mortality, functional recovery), using single or multimodal (clinical, imaging, biomarker) data.
42523910.headline_result: AUROC up to 0.98 for mortality prediction; marginal gains over no-information rate for low-risk triage

42527308.model_family: deep learning survival model (ResNet-based) with late fusion
42527308.clinical_problem: Risk stratification (survival prediction) in pediatric low-grade glioma integrating deep learning imaging features, molecular subtype, and clinical data, with uncertainty quantification
42527308.patient_population: 360 subjects with imaging data, 493 with molecular subtype data, Children's Brain Tumor Network
42527308.model_description: A pretrained deep learning model fine-tuned for pediatric brain tumor segmentation extracts imaging features from T2-weighted MRI, which are combined in a regularized survival model (clinico-ResNet) with clinical data, and further fused with a clinical-molecular survival model; bootstrap resampling quantifies per-patient prediction uncertainty for risk stratification in pediatric low-grade glioma.
42527308.dataset_size: 360 subjects with imaging (752 for segmentation fine-tuning), 493 with molecular data, 294 with both
42527308.headline_result: DL-M1 C-index 0.73 discovery, 0.70 replication; multimodal fusion reduced uncertainty interval width by approximately 75%
42527308.study_design: retrospective multicenter cohort study with deep learning survival modeling and independent replication
